data.body: **[P2] Keep the overflow decision bounded in memory.** Every oversized payload is first expanded into a complete escaped JSON envelope, and `fitsCheckpoint` then allocates another full UTF-8 copy. After deciding to offload it, `writePayload` allocates yet another payload-sized byte array. Payloads large enough to need this feature can therefore exhaust the Lambda heap before a file reference is returned. Measure the envelope with a capped streaming/counting encoder, materialize it only when it fits, and stream file encoding through a bounded buffer; add a multi-megabyte regression test.
